name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.9 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 4 visits over 57 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2025-07-21, at wavelengths from 1.21 to 4.94 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
